svg.title: Agent Direct
svg.desc: You to AI assistant: States the task and its limits. AI assistant to Kit and repository: Starts work on a branch. Command: agentic-kit work start. AI assistant to AI assistant: Makes the change and runs the project tests. AI assistant to Kit and repository: Runs the repository checks. Command: agentic-kit check. Kit and repository to AI assistant: Reports success or a failure that stops the flow. AI assistant to Kit and repository: Checks project health. Command: agentic-kit doctor. AI assistant to You: Presents the change and check results for review. You to AI assistant: Approves or rejects the change. AI assistant to Kit and repository: After approval, asks the Kit to commit, open the PR, wait for CI and merge. Command: agentic-kit work finish. Kit and repository to AI assistant: Reports the completed merge or blocks on failure. AI assistant to Kit and repository: Requests a validated handoff. Command: agentic-kit transfer chat-switch-complete.
